objectives.text: Explain what the back end's dev profile that keeps endpoints open does, and why it must never be active outside local development
Start the back end without the dev profile by changing its active Spring profiles, and point the front end at it with a Vite environment variable
Verify after the switch that an unauthenticated request is now refused (401 or 403, depending on the back end's security configuration) and that the front end handles the refusal

minutes.basis: Measured on the authored artifact.html with the frozen estimator (authoring/tools/timing/estimate_reading.py): P50 6.7 minutes. Worst required path models one additional wrong graded attempt per interactive unit before it settles, at the estimator cost table (1 predict at 30 s, 1 explore at 20 s, 2 terminal_step at 35 s, 1 mcq at 45 s): 9.45 minutes. Budget and about label are 10: the larger of the intake plan of 10 and ceil(max(P50, worst path)), under the 15-minute ceiling (authoring/docs/tools/validators.md). This is a model, not a measurement with learners. Re-synced 2026-11-20 after a learner-text wording pass: estimator P50 6.7 -> 6.75; modeledWorstPath shifted by the same delta (9.45 -> 9.5); budget and aboutLabel unchanged.
